title: Purdue University Global (PurdueGlobal)

sections.heading: What PurdueGlobal is known for
paragraphs: Purdue University Global (PurdueGlobal) is known for its extensive online education programs, serving a large undergraduate population of 30,828 students. Approximately 37.31% of its programs are dedicated to business studies, making it a prominent area of study at the university. Health programs also represent a substantial portion, accounting for about 19.9% of the academic offerings. PurdueGlobal's emphasis on accessible online education caters to a diverse student body seeking flexible learning opportunities.
